description: A gray tray with small clear ice cubes sits on the bed next to a yellow cup, with a purple scoop to the right and a pink sheet draped in the background. The left hand reaches down to grasp the yellow cup, lifts it and moves it over the tray, then tips it to scoop and dump ice inside the tray before rotating it back upright and setting it down beside the tray; the right hand stays resting on the bed and does not touch any object.
